AzureAd.//ClientId: Core app (ADR-015). Locally: dotnet user-secrets set AzureAd:ClientId <guid> -p src/Mlcp.Sync.
AzureAd.//UsageInsightsClientId: Usage Insights app (Reports.Read.All, ADR-015). Required outside Development.

Mlcp.//KeyVaultUri: Key Vault holding the shared client certificate; with ClientCertificateName, required outside Development.

Identity.//SendCertificateChain: Only true when the registrations trust the certificate by subject name and issuer.

ServiceBus.//FullyQualifiedNamespace: e.g. mlcp-prod.servicebus.windows.net; uses Managed Identity. ConnectionStrings:ServiceBus is for the local emulator only.

MicrosoftApi.//: Base address overrides for tests and sovereign clouds. Empty means the public cloud.

ConnectionStrings.//: Local values come from user-secrets or docker compose; production from Key Vault via Managed Identity.

Sync.//JobQueueName: Sessions are enabled on this queue so job ordering is preserved within a tenant (docs/03-architecture.md §6.1).
